name: edit_asset
description:
Update or delete a library asset.

- update: change asset-level fields. Code update transport depends on the current agent surface. For other fields use json (e.g. filename, sourceLut). type is optional for update and inferred from assetId.
- Motion-graphic properties schema uses {key,label,type,defaultValue}. To change existing asset-level default values, use propertyDefaults:{key:value}. Clip-level MG values use edit_item propertyOverrides.
- Prefer propertyDefaults for Motion Graphic asset default values. Legacy top-level property keys such as logoImage/titleText/fontFamily are normalized to propertyDefaults only when type:"motion-graphic" is explicit; height/width remain clip/source dimensions, and duration is normalized to durationInSeconds.
- Source LUT on original media: set sourceLut:null on video/image/gif to remove, or sourceLut:{assetId} to apply. This grades the source asset itself, so it changes every timeline instance of that asset on every timeline — when the request is about one clip or one range, use edit_item with the LUT asset id instead. assetId must be an existing LUT effect asset — a built-in ("builtin:slog3-s709", "builtin:canon-log3-709") or a project asset from browse_assets type:"effect" whose editableProperties include a lut-typed key; prefix ids resolve like everywhere else, and an id that matches no LUT asset is rejected instead of applied. The stored display name is derived from the resolved asset.
- delete: remove the asset and any items/effects/transitions that reference it. If references exist, the tool first returns the impact and requires confirmImpact:true before deleting.

Asset properties live on the asset; clip-level position and per-instance overrides live on the item — use edit_item for those.

This runtime cannot read the agent's workspace files. For code-based assets, set the complete replacement source inline in json.code.

ChatCut Desktop accepts expectedRevision with an inline code update so its local workspace adapter can preserve stale-write protection. The Desktop adapter owns codeFile resolution; the backend never reads that path.

confirmImpact.description: For action=delete only: pass true only after the user confirms the reported timeline impact.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by Desktop inspect_asset includeCodeFile. Used with the Desktop adapter's inline code update to reject stale Motion Graphic source.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.
